system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or Higher. Deal [3D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target, and the target takes [Dazed].

(Target: Flying): Increase the damage by +[STR base].

A special skill that allows you to change the trajectory of your attack by lightly flipping your body around, like a swallow, and catch your enemy by surprise. Your body perfectly reproduces Hien's movements, which were difficult for even ancient swordsmen to capture.
